newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Second Chance doubles IPO price at debut.
newsitem.headline: Second Chance doubles IPO price at debut.

text.p: Shares in gold and fashion retailer Second Chance Enterprises Ltd reached a high of Singapore $0.60 on their first day of trading on Friday.
This was double the S$0.30 issue price at the company's initial public offering (IPO) of shares.
The shares later slipped back to trade around S$0.565.
In the first 10 minutes of trading, around 12 million shares in the company changed hands.
The company had offered a total of 19 million new shares in its IPO, of which 9.5 million were available for the public. This public tranche was 95.6 times subscribed.
Second Chance is listed on Singapore's secondary share board, SESDAQ.
